source.check: 'W. M. C. Gillespie' among those present at the Limavady Guardians in October 1927 (Derry Journal, 26 October 1927, p. 3) and November 1927 (16 November 1927, p. 7); present throughout the term and returned again for Faughanvale in 1933 ('(old)').

note: Triennial election of Limavady rural district (23 divisions, one member each). Seventeen nominations were received for sixteen divisions; the seven divisions with no nomination (Ballyhargan, Ballykelly, Bellarena, Benone, Drum, Faughanvale and Killywool) had their retiring members deemed re-elected (Belfast News-Letter, 22 and 29 April 1927), but those members are not named in the reports read; three are recorded from reports of the new council's meetings (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Straw was the only contest. Polled Friday 27 May 1927: 'Polling took place yesterday in the Bellarena division of county Londonderry, the only division in the county where there was a contest' for the county council (Londonderry Sentinel, Saturday 28 May 1927, p. 8), and the Limavady rural contest in Straw 'took place on Friday' (Derry Journal, 30 May 1927, p. 8). No nomination: the retiring member was deemed re-elected (Belfast News-Letter, 22 and 29 April 1927). Division inferred from the 30 May 1924 return (William M. C. Gillespie, Londonderry Sentinel, 1924-04-26, p. 2); the reports of the new council's meetings name him as a member. No co-option or by-election in this division was found in 1927-30. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
